comments.author: @jacksonmiller9780
comments.text: When the volcano erupted in 1961 and they were evacuated to England, almost every single family chose to return to this rock. That says everything about the power of home and community.

replies.author: @Reallifeinsights.26
replies.text: Spot on! That evacuation showed the world that having more choices doesn't always lead to greater happiness. In the UK, the islanders found traffic, locked doors, and a culture where neighbors barely spoke to one another. Returning to Edinburgh of the Seven Seas was their way of declaring that an egalitarian life based on shared fishing, planting potatoes together, and deep kinship was worth all the physical hardship in the world.
